title: Parties gear up for 3 city corporation polls

slides.head: Parties gear up for 3 city corporation polls
What happened
slides.body: AIMIM floor leader Akbaruddin Owaisi has visited Chandrayangutta, Hafez Babanagar and Riyasatnagar and met traffic police on road safety.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: AIMIM won 44 of 150 wards in each of the last two GHMC elections and wants to contest the new corporations too.

slides.head: Corporations going to polls
slides.body: GHMC's ward count has grown after delimitation added Shamshabad, Jalpally, Adibatla, Badangpet and Meerpet.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: AIMIM won 44 of 150 wards in each of the last two GHMC elections.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: The State Election Commission's poll schedule for the three corporations. Ask: How many wards does GHMC now have after delimitation?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

Parties gear up for 3 city corporation polls

Elections to GHMC and the new Malkajgiri and Cyberabad corporations are expected soon; AIMIM has stepped up outreach.

Why it matters: AIMIM won 44 of 150 wards in each of the last two GHMC elections and wants to contest the new corporations too.
